title: what is happening to me... (part 2)
content: So that it doesn't get so long, I continue here with the second thing that happens to me, and the one that seems most disturbing to me. This is something that only happens to me when I take a "nap", that is, I sleep at odd hours and it is still daytime. I suppose it's because I can't relax completely, because I don't want to sleep for too long, or because I'm not used to sleeping at that time (I hate naps for this reason) but sometimes due to work schedules it's necessary... .and although it rationalizes what happens, it doesn't make it any less surreal. I have had some sleep paralysis, but rarely, the most normal thing is that two things happen to me: \- Let reality mix with dreams... What I see is what there is, for example my room, and even if someone comes in I can talk to that person (I have had conversations) and be aware of what we are talking about, but sometimes at the same time, see impossible things. Once, I saw how my dolls began to come down from the shelves, while I was asking my boy about the game he was playing, and if he saw anything strange in the room… \- False awakenings that are very very very realistic and vivid, in them I come to suspect at some point that I am dreaming, but when I fail to wake up I begin to look for things that are wrong in that reality. For example: A few days ago I "woke up" in the middle of a street in my city, with a shopping cart in my hand and very disconcerted... I looked around and the only thing I could think of was that I had fallen asleep walking. . I got scared and started looking for my cell phone, then a lady saw me and asked me if I was okay, that I had a bad face...she helped me sit in a doorway and then I don't know why I thought: this is a dream. I started looking around looking for something wrong, but couldn't find anything. After almost going crazy, I realized that what was wrong was the doorway itself, it didn't belong to that street, but to another nearby...there I woke up and it took me a while to focus on my reality again.
